# Breadcrumb props

## Breadcrumb.Root Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `labels` | `Partial<BreadcrumbLabels>` | — | Replaces the built-in English strings, e.g. to translate them. Keys you leave out keep the default from `DEFAULT_BREADCRUMB_LABELS`. `aria-label` on Root takes precedence. |

## Breadcrumb.Link Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `render` | `RenderElement$1` | — | Custom link element to render instead of a native `<a>` (e.g. `<Link to="..." />`). |

## Labels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `root` | `string` | `"Breadcrumb"` | Name of the `Breadcrumb.Root` navigation landmark. |
| `ellipsis` | `string` | `"More"` | Text of `Breadcrumb.Ellipsis` for screen readers, which read it in place of the three dots. It is visually hidden. |
